Name: Jehudijah
Summary: Wife of Mered who bore Jered, Heber, and Jekuthiel.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 4:18: Wife of Mered who bore Jered, Heber, and Jekuthiel.
LifeLesson: The mention of Jehudijah in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.
